objective: Compare native-resolution ball-center localization across model size and training data

validation.selection: highest full-validation center5 F1 at conf=.25; ties choose latest checkpoint
validation.early_stopping: 20 epochs without strict center5 F1 improvement

additional_policy: Include all verified additional_v1 images, including 2997 white-background train-parent variants; native means image resolution, not exclusion of these variants
holdout_policy: Keep original v1 val/test unchanged; no additional images enter holdouts; exact content and known-parent overlap checked; independence of unknown historical recording families is not established
